All Members, 
 
Muhurat Trading session on account of Diwali 
 
In continuation to circular No. NSE/FAOP/71777 dated December 12, 2025, a special live trading session shall 
be held on Sunday, November 08, 2026 on account of Muhurat trading on Diwali as per the following schedule: 
 
Diwali Muhurat Trading Session on Sunday , November 08, 2026
